name: clamp_position
description: Decode position clamp with signature clamp_position(seq_lens). Given a one-dimensional integer tensor of sequence lengths, return a newly allocated tensor of the same shape and dtype with out[i] = max(seq_lens[i] - 1, 0). The operation is elementwise and exact; seq_lens is not modified. The suite exercises int32 and int64 lengths from 1 to 16384 elements, including zero lengths.
